thread:
Erin (CS): Heads-up — Brightline onboarding is stuck during org setup. They report the SSO step never finishes: "keeps spinning on 'verifying' for >10 min". Renewal is next month so this is a renewal-risk signal from the AM.

Jill (CS Ops): Any logs or steps from the customer?

Erin (CS): Customer steps: 1) invite admin 2) paste IdP metadata 3) click 'verify'. They sent this log snippet: ```
2026-03-22T14:11:02Z ERROR saml/verify.go:42 verify timeout: callback not received
504 from /api/onboard/saml/callback?org=brightline
```
They see a 504 when our callback endpoint should be called.

Sam (PM): This smells like a callback/webhook mismatch or the onboarding worker queue dropping the callback. Marking as P0 for onboarding completion until we confirm. Ping @Ravi for infra triage. Also adding to product tracker: https://redwood.example.com/feedback/BR-8145

Ravi (Eng): On it — I can reproduce locally using their metadata. Suspect a race with token rotation + callback handler. I'll open a minimal repro and link a GH issue. ETA: EOD. Assigning to eng-oncall to watch.

oncall-bot: Deployment queued: staging build #1298 for quick fix verification.

Jill (CS Ops): :eyes: Erin, can CS offer a short workaround to keep them moving?

Erin (CS): I offered manual-invite + temporary SAML bypass (manual mapping via admin UI); customer accepted that for now. Updating renewal risk -> lowered for now. Logged two product asks from the call: 1) clearer UX/error when callback fails (P2), 2) SSO setup wizard + test-idp tool (P3). Will add both to the ticket.

Sam (PM): Thanks — I'll move BR-8145 to "triage" and add labels: onboarding-blocker, sso, renewal-risk. Can someone draft a 2-3 bullet note for the account team to send to Brightline? They want a simple status update.

Erin (CS): I'll draft an email in #accounts now and paste it here for review.

Ravi (Eng): Created GH issue: https://github.com/redwood/infra/issues/7206. I'll post ongoing updates there. If the fix looks risky we'll canary to Brightline's org only. :white_check_mark:

Jill (CS Ops): Great — thanks everyone. I'll mark this thread as 'customer workaround applied' and follow up tomorrow morning with AM on renewal cadence.
